guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at the step installing packages with apt-get. Specifically, the error is: "E: Unable to locate package python3.9-venv". This indicates that the package python3.9-venv does not exist in the default Ubuntu 22.04 repositories under that name. Ubuntu 22.04 (Jammy) uses Python 3.10 by default, so the python3.9 packages are likely unavailable. To fix this, update the Dockerfile to install python3.10 and python3.10-venv instead of python3.9 and python3.9-venv, or alternatively use the default python3 aliases. For example, replace all python3.9 references with python3 or python3.10 as appropriate. After adjusting the Python version, verify that all other Python package installations and commands reflect this Python version change. This change should fix the package installation error and allow the Dockerfile to build successfully.
